resources.string:
1. Set up
Open Writing Settings, add your Gemini API key, and choose your model. AI tools need an internet connection. The text or image you choose is sent to the AI provider.

2. Edit text
Write in a text field or select the part you want to change. Tap the magic icon → Edit text. Choose Proofread for spelling and grammar, Rephrase for clearer wording, or another style. Correct text may need only one proofreading result.

3. Draft a reply
Copy a message first, then choose Reply to copied text. For a photo or post, use Choose an image, Recent screenshot, or Capture screen. Screen capture asks for permission. Check the chosen image before using its reply.

4. Continue writing
Start a sentence, then choose Continue writing. Suggestions add new text after your existing words.

5. Review and insert
Use Previous and Next to compare results. Tap Insert or tap the result to place it in your text field; hold the result to copy. Try again requests new options. Return to the keyboard to cancel.

Example
Write: “I has a meeting tomorrow.”
Choose Edit text → Proofread.
Expected correction: “I have a meeting tomorrow.”

Better results
Include the relevant context, names and dates. Use a clear photo with readable text. Check names, numbers and meaning before sending. AI can still make mistakes. If a request fails, check your connection and API key in Writing Settings, then retry.
